name: βk-2C-B
aliases: bk-2cb, bk-2-cb, b-k-2cb, b-k2cb, b-k2-cb, b-k2-c-b, b-k-2-c-b, bk2cb
summary: A long-acting psychedelic and empathogen with unpredictable effectiveness. Roughly double the duration of 2C-B. Inactivated by high pH.

pharmacology.text: βk-2C-B acts as a very-low-potency serotonin 5-HT2A receptor partial agonist. Its EC50 was found to be 905 nM and its Emax was 41%. For comparison, 2C-B had an EC50 of 9.0 nM and an Emax of 89% in the same study. In another study, βk-2C-B's EC50 at the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor was 6,732 nM, compared to 0.28 nM in the case of 2C-I and 0.78 nM in the case of 2C-E (2C-B was not reported).
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: βk-2C-B was not included nor mentioned in Alexander Shulgin's book PiHKAL (Phenethylamines I Have Known and Loved). However, it subsequently emerged as a novel recreational designer drug and its properties and effects were reported. βk-2C-B is usually taken orally, but may also be used by other routes. Insufflation is said to be not well-tolerated.

sideEffects.en: Reported effects include nausea, anxiety, a raised heart rate and blood pressure, and confusion, and its long duration can make a difficult experience hard to sit out. Like other psychedelics, it can trigger psychosis in people who are prone to it.
sideEffects.zh: 回報的反應包括噁心、焦慮、心跳與血壓上升以及混亂，而它作用時間長，使難受的經驗更難撐過。和其他迷幻藥一樣，它可能在易感者身上誘發精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 回报的反应包括恶心、焦虑、心跳与血压上升以及混乱，而它作用时间长，使难受的经验更难撑过。和其他迷幻药一样，它可能在易感者身上诱发精神病。

fact.en: It is 2C-B with an oxygen double bonded to the side chain, the beta keto group. That one addition makes it hundreds of times weaker at the 5-HT2A receptor than 2C-B itself.
fact.zh: 它是在 2C-B 側鏈上以雙鍵接一個氧，也就是 β 位的酮基。僅僅這項改動就使它在 5-HT2A 受體上的效力比 2C-B 本身弱上數百倍。
fact.zhHans: 它是在 2C-B 侧链上以双键接一个氧，也就是 β 位的酮基。仅仅这项改动就使它在 5-HT2A 受体上的效力比 2C-B 本身弱上数百倍。
